import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { customer } from "./customer";

export const employee = defineTable("employee", {
    columns: {
        employeeId: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        lastName: col.varchar({ length: 20 }).notNull(),
        firstName: col.varchar({ length: 20 }).notNull(),
        title: col.varchar({ length: 30 }),
        reportsTo: col.integer(),
        birthDate: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        hireDate: col.custom({ dataType: "timestamp without time zone" }),
        address: col.varchar({ length: 70 }),
        city: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        state: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        country: col.varchar({ length: 40 }),
        postalCode: col.varchar({ length: 10 }),
        phone: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        fax: col.varchar({ length: 24 }),
        email: col.varchar({ length: 60 })
    },
    relations: {
        reportsToRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => employee, { localKey: "reports_to", onDelete: "no action" }),
        customer: rel.hasMany(() => customer, { foreignKey: "support_rep_id" }),
        employee: rel.hasMany(() => employee, { foreignKey: "reports_to" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
